findings.a_plugin_from_layer: loads; a ./relative name resolves against the --patch layer file location; absolute path and file:// URL also load
findings.b_single_file_plugin: node: imports + ctx only (inject ['tools']) registers pre-execute/execute/post-execute prepend+global and tools/result global; sees subagent calls (exec.agent.id = subagent id, rootCallId = its own callId, no parent token)
findings.b_subagent_calls_not_on_acp: subagent tool calls reach the plugin but emit NO ACP tool_call/tool_call_update; the subagent tool returns immediately (started subagent <id>)
findings.b_prepend_not_outermost: tool-jobs registers a prepend pre-execute listener AFTER the plugin and runs before it; spill-policy likewise on post-execute
findings.c_inventory: ctx.events._hooks[event] (private) lists {ctx, callback, prepend, global}; owner = hook.ctx.fiber.entry.options.id/name
findings.d_no_listener: ss -ltunp shows no listening socket for the dsh pid at session/new and after prompt; lsof -i only an outbound connection to the LLM origin
findings.e_fd_inheritance: bash children hold only fds 0,1,2 on BOTH paths (systemd-run --user --scope when XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set; direct spawn under the Nassaj exact env, cgroup = pm2 service); sandboxed children get EPERM on pidfd_getfd and /proc/<dsh>/mem; an APPROVED escalation (sandbox_permissions danger-full-access) child takes fd 3 and fd 7 via pidfd_getfd and reads /proc/<dsh>/mem (host ptrace_scope=0)
findings.f_non_ready: malformed JSON args and non-object args (array, string) fail the WHOLE turn in the DeepSeek Messages decoder (JSON-RPC -32603) before any tool_call or pipeline event; unknown tool DOES reach pre-execute and execute and fails in the body; cancel during the body: pre-execute and execute ran, post-execute isError "tool call aborted", the command did not finish
findings.f_raw_arguments: no raw argument text on either side: the plugin sees deep-frozen parsed exec.arguments, ACP sees parsed rawInput; JSON.stringify of both is identical for every root call in the recording
findings.tool_args_validated_in_body: schema validation (e.g. bash missing description) runs inside the body after pre-execute and execute listeners
findings.tool_env: bash tool env has no DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (dsh strips it)
